name: Gorilla Heights 2
summary: Gorilla Heights 2 takes your favorite gorilla movement to even greater heights, bringing brand-new vertically focused maps that push your skills to the limit as you swing, climb, and race your friends to insane new peaks. Discover hidden pathways, master advanced climbing techniques, and experience smoother, more refined movement while tackling intricate level designs that demand precision and timing.
